cards.text: Big day, friend. Joshua, Israel's leader, calls in the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and he tells them, “You have done all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and you have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you.”

cards.question: True or false: Joshua says these three tribes have stuck by their brothers this whole time.

cards.text: Now that the LORD has given their brothers rest, Joshua says the two sweetest words there are: GO HOME. Back across the Jordan, to the land Moses gave them.

cards.question: Before they go, Joshua tells the three tribes to be very careful to keep the law Moses gave them. What's at the heart of it?

answers.text: Love the LORD and hold fast to Him
Guard the Jordan and keep the peace
Bring their wealth to the tabernacle

cards.text: So Joshua blesses them and sends them home. Quick note on Manasseh: Moses gave half of them land in Bashan, and Joshua gave the other half land on the west side of the Jordan, among their brothers.

cards.question: As he blesses them, Joshua tells the three tribes to take their great wealth home and ___ the spoil of their enemies with their brothers.

cards.text: They leave the rest of Israel at Shiloh, headed home to their own land of Gilead, LOADED: silver, gold, bronze, iron, herds of livestock and very many clothes. When I left my junk drawer, all I took was my mustache, so baker, I am IMPRESSED.
On the way, at Geliloth near the Jordan, they stop and build something. And friend, it is NOT small.

cards.question: At Geliloth by the Jordan, the three tribes build an imposing ___.
Word reaches the rest of Israel. True or false: the report says the altar is out in Gilead, on the far side of the Jordan.

cards.text: Israel hears the news. And baker, when I say everybody heads to Shiloh, I mean EVERYBODY.

cards.question: The whole congregation of Israel gathers at Shiloh. What do they plan to do about the three tribes who built the altar?

cards.text: But first, Israel sends someone across to Gilead: Phinehas, son of Eleazar the priest.

cards.question: Israel sends ten chiefs along with Phinehas. Who are they?

answers.text: One family leader from each tribe

cards.text: They reach Gilead and speak for the whole congregation of the LORD. No hello, no how was the trip, baker, they go STRAIGHT in.

cards.question: What do Phinehas and the chiefs say this altar means the three tribes are doing?

cards.text: Then they bring up the sin of Peor. They say Israel still hasn't been cleansed of it, and it brought a plague on the congregation of the LORD.

cards.question: True or false: the leaders warn that if these three tribes rebel against the LORD, He will be angry only with them.
The leaders make an offer. If the land across the Jordan is unclean, what can the three tribes do?

answers.text: Cross over and settle among them
Build a tabernacle of their own

cards.question: Last, the leaders bring up Achan son of Zerah, who was unfaithful about what was set apart for destruction. True or false: Achan was the only one who died because of his sin.

cards.text: Now the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh get their turn to answer. They open with one line, and they say it twice: “The LORD, the Mighty One, is God!”

cards.question: True or false: the three tribes say that if this altar was rebellion against the LORD, Israel should not spare them.

cards.text: They go even further. If they built it to turn away from Him and offer sacrifices on it, they say, may the LORD Himself hold them accountable.
So why build it? They say it was fear: one day, Israel's descendants might look across the Jordan and say something to theirs.

cards.question: What are the three tribes afraid Israel's descendants will one day say to theirs?

answers.text: You have no share in the LORD

cards.text: So, they say, they built an altar, but not for burnt offerings or sacrifices. Baker, that's like buying an oven you never turn on.

cards.question: The altar isn't for sacrifices. The tribes say it's meant to be a ___ between them, Israel and the generations to come.

cards.text: A witness that they will worship the LORD in His presence with burnt offerings, sacrifices and peace offerings. Friend, their altar is a sign that says WE BELONG TO THE LORD TOO.

cards.question: If anyone ever tells their descendants they have no share in the LORD, what will the three tribes tell them to look at?

answers.text: A replica of the LORD's altar

cards.question: The three tribes say far be it from them to ___ against the LORD by building an altar for offerings other than the altar of the LORD their God.

cards.text: Phinehas and the chiefs hear every word. And I bet those three tribes are holding their breath, the way I did every time that junk drawer opened.

cards.question: True or false: Phinehas and the chiefs are satisfied with what the three tribes have to say.

cards.text: Then Phinehas says, “Today we know that the LORD is among us, because you have not committed this breach of faith against Him.”

cards.question: Phinehas tells the three tribes that by not breaking faith, they have delivered Israel from what?

cards.text: Then Phinehas and the other leaders head back to the Israelites in Canaan with the report.

cards.question: When Israel hears the report from Phinehas, what do they do?

answers.text: Bless God and drop the war

cards.question: The Reubenites and Gadites give their altar by the Jordan a name. What is it?

cards.text: And they say why: “It is a witness between us that the LORD is God.” Baker, a whole imposing altar, built just to say that out loud? I LOVE it.
